in.rationale: Irving et al. leave open a natural debate protocol for stochastic simulation, since bisection only works for deterministic simulation. text: The authors note that their PSPACE reduction for long simulations works only for deterministic simulation: if each step adds noise, a misaligned Alice could choose the noise so every single step looks plausible while the final result has extremely low probability. Fixing the random seed preserves PSPACE equivalence but the resulting protocol is likely unlearnable by practical agents, especially in chaotic environments, and they leave a natural debate protocol for stochastic simulation open.
title: Open: debate protocol for stochastic simulation (bisection works only if deterministic)
